executiveSummary: Active OT targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs across multiple sectors, with guidance from U.S. government agencies detailing S7comm abuse and Python/snap7 tooling. Immediate hardening and TCP/102 blocking recommended. Security Advisory Trivially exploitable OpenSSH authentication bypass on musl-based systems (Alpine, embedded/IIoT) risks direct shell access to OT gateways and appliances; exploitation scanning is widespread. Patch or disable password auth now. Security Advisory Supporting Report Iran-linked sabotage of supermarket refrigeration control systems at ~700 sites demonstrates real-world OT setpoint manipulation impacts to cold-chain operations. Segment BMS/OT and remove internet exposure. View Article Industrial gateways and protocol bridges with unauthenticated command/code execution (e.g., Advantech EKI-1242/EIMS; LoRaWAN gateways; EV chargers) present near-term plant-floor disruption and pivot risks. CISA Bulletin CISA Bulletin China-nexus covert networks and FSB Center 16 router campaigns continue leveraging compromised SOHO/edge devices for pre-positioning in critical infrastructure; harden SNMP/SMI and remove internet-exposed management. Security Advisory Security Advisory Ransomware ecosystems (Gunra, SafePay) remain active with VPN/firewall exploitation and living-off-the-land techniques that can cascade from IT into OT if segmentation and identity controls are weak. CISA Advisory CISA Advisory Actively exploited VPN and webmail vulnerabilities (SonicWall SSLVPN; Zimbra XSS) elevate initial-access risk; prioritize KEV remediation and compromise assessments. descriptions: Edge and VPN exploitation for initial access (T1190), including SonicWall SSLVPN (KEV) and Zimbra webmail XSS (email-borne execution).
Living-off-the-land (PowerShell/WMI/WinRM/Impacket) and valid accounts (T1078) for lateral movement; data staging and exfiltration (T1041) to cloud storage.
Proxy and covert network use (T1090) via SOHO routers/IoT to mask attribution and maintain persistence near CI perimeters.
ICS-specific protocol manipulation: S7comm (TCP/102) read/write; OPC UA auth and policy weaknesses; unauthenticated gateway management ports.

outlook72h: Patch and/or mitigate OpenSSH musl systems; if uncertain, disable password authentication and restrict SSH to jump hosts only. Implement immediate ACLs and monitoring on industrial gateways (Advantech, OPC UA endpoints, EVSE OCPP), and remove internet exposure. Harden PLC perimeters: block TCP/102 from non-engineering subnets; review last 30 days of S7comm activity and logic change logs. Execute KEV-driven patch/change windows for SonicWall SSLVPN and review for pre-patch compromise. Conduct focused hunts for Zimbra Flowerbed/Catcher TTPs and revoke risky app passwords and 2FA scratch codes.
